authority: The class set and each class's acceptability are owned by CODE, not by this asset. validateGoldenDifferenceTaxonomy refuses an asset that drops a class, invents one, flips an acceptability, or paraphrases what a class detects. Editing this file cannot make a never-acceptable difference approvable.
primary_economic_truth: The canonical Economic IR (economic-ir/1.0), compiled in shadow beside the proof projection. NOT the emitted workbook.
regeneration_gate: Regeneration requires an approval record in goldens/approval-ledger.jsonl naming a human actor, a reason of at least 40 characters, the fixtures, the difference classes, and the commit the approval was granted against. The approval is single-use. Regeneration is refused outright when any observed difference is never-acceptable, regardless of approval.
never_acceptable_meaning: A never-acceptable difference is a regression, not a change. It is fixed in the code that produced it and never by moving the golden. No actor, reason, commit or approval can authorise regenerating past one.

contract_version_bump.detects: a declared contract version moved (economic-ir, typed_financial_value, schedule_typed_states or the proof projection schema).

coverage_census_drift.detects: the twelve-state census moved in a direction that is not a never-zero collapse.

economic_drift.detects: the Economic IR seal content hash moved: economic truth changed.

fixture_identity_drift.detects: case_id, case_sha256 or evidence_epoch_sha256 moved: the fixture itself was re-cut.

golden_coverage_gap.detects: a certified fixture has no golden record, or a golden record names a fixture that no longer exists. Deleting a golden is not a way to pass.

golden_record_corruption.detects: the golden record on disk does not satisfy its schema or its own record_sha256; it was edited after sealing.

historical_basis_drift.detects: the historical_basis histogram or the economic node count moved.

never_zero_collapse.detects: a never-zero state became a number: bare_number_slots moved off 0, or never-zero slots collapsed into value-bearing readings, or a schedule family's not_applicable slots became numbers. This is the regression the freeze exists to catch.

schedule_shape_drift.detects: the forecast schedule period count, period ids, or a family's slot count or non-collapse state mix moved.

shadow_boundary_violation.detects: the Economic IR stopped being shadow: mode, gates_delivery, shadow status, or the non-enumerable attachment changed. Promoting the IR is a new schema version, never a golden update.

slot_shape_drift.detects: a typed-slot shape count moved (total, historical, forecast, schedule, value-bearing or never-zero).

uncertified_golden_present.detects: golden records exist but there is no approval ledger, so nothing certifies them. Shedding the certification history while keeping the records is not a route back to PRE_FREEZE.

unclassified_difference.detects: a pinned fact differs and no declared class named it. A new pinned fact must get a class before it can ever be approved.
